_comment: Copy to config.json and fill it in. Claude can fill it for you: run the pitchmap skill and describe what you sell.
_mode_help: fix = you sell the fix for a problem their website shows (web design, SEO, booking...). offer = you sell any product or service to businesses and only need a relevant reason to write.

business.name: Your Studio
business.postal_address: Your real business address, City, Country

offer.what: clean, modern websites for local {plural}: mobile-first, secure, with a big "Call now" button and a quote form
offer.cta: Happy to mock up a new homepage for you for free so you can see the difference before deciding anything. Want me to send one over?

signals.line: your site doesn't load securely (no padlock), and some browsers warn visitors before they even see it
the site isn't set up for phones, so on a mobile it shows up tiny and hard to tap
the footer still says {year}, and some people take that as a sign the business might not be around anymore
Google doesn't have a proper description for your site, so search results show a random chunk of text instead of a real pitch
the site is built with very old code, which tends to look broken on today's phones
there's no way to book online, so every job starts with a phone call
there's no tap-to-call button, so people on a phone have to copy your number by hand

replies.price: On price: it starts at {price}, one-time, depending on what you need.
